Lesson 11.4 · 22 min · Verified 17 Jul 2026

Working-capital and trade-finance vocabulary

After this lesson you can:
  • Explain receivable, inventory and purchase-order finance
  • Distinguish invoice discounting, factoring and supply-chain finance
  • Map trade instruments to contingent and funded exposure
On this page
  1. Finance follows the operating cycle
  2. Who owes whom
  3. Trade instruments
  4. Where this lives in LoanOS
  5. Knowledge check

1. Finance follows the operating cycle

Working capital bridges purchase, inventory, sale and collection.

Receivable finance advances against an invoice; purchase-order finance funds fulfilment before invoice; inventory finance relies on eligible stock.

A borrowing base applies eligibility, concentration, ageing, dilution and margin rules.

2. Who owes whom

Invoice discounting usually leaves collection with the seller; factoring may transfer collection and administration to the factor.

Recourse decides whether the seller must repay if the buyer does not.

Supply-chain finance is a programme connecting anchor, suppliers and approved payables, with anchor concentration and dispute risk.

3. Trade instruments

A letter of credit is a conditional bank undertaking against compliant documents.

A bank guarantee is contingent support against beneficiary demand under its terms.

Bill purchase/discounting creates funded exposure.

Document presentation, discrepancy, expiry, devolvement and crystallisation are lifecycle events — not notes in a comments box.

Regulatory anchors

  • RBI-KFS-2024 — Applicable borrower economics must remain disclosed.
  • RBI-IT-GRC — Trade states and document conditions require traceable processing.

Family IDs resolve in the India regulatory register (docs/compliance/india-regulatory-register.md), which owns sources and caveats.

Where this lives in LoanOS

  • Capability PRD-001 — Product structures.
  • Capability COL-002 — Receivables and guarantees as supported security forms.
  • Capability DSB-007 — Supplier and invoice-linked payment.

Key terms

Escrow Conditions precedent GST

Knowledge check

1. What does recourse decide in receivable finance?

  1. Invoice tax rate
  2. Who ultimately bears buyer non-payment under the contract
  3. Which bank account receives funds
  4. The invoice date
Show answer

B. Recourse allocates ultimate payment responsibility between seller and financier.
